checkedAlternates.risk: Cellophane noodles and rice vermicelli are both thin white/clear noodles.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Cellophane glass noodles are made from mung bean starch (group-1), whereas rice vermicelli is made from rice flour (group-3).

checkedAlternates.risk: Thick white udon looks pale like wide rice noodles.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Udon is kneaded from wheat flour, water, and salt (group-4), not rice flour (group-3).
